name: TTKillerPlus
description: TTKillerPlus is a modified TikTok by iKarwan. Download videos from the feed, stories and Explore, save photos and profile avatars, merge post photos with their music, block promoted posts and ads, toggle seen/unseen, hide tabs, browse the feed of a specific country, show country flags and post dates, and auto-like in live streams. iPadOS supported.
shortDescription: TikTok with downloads, no ads and region switch
changelog:
TikTok 46.7.0 | TikTok_46.7_TTKillerPlus_2.1

• Add v46.0+ compatibility.
• Fix like confirmation bypass on double tap.
• Fix post date display format.
• Fix settings localization & toggles.
• Fix flag button not tappable.
• Other fixes & improvements.
• Update base IPA to TikTok v46.7
